svg.title: What the allocator fix changed
svg.desc: Two time-lapses of a 2000 MB address space, one row per load, with objects of about 600 MB loaded every ten minutes. Before the fix, single pages are left across the address space and load 20 fails with 1384 MB free. After the fix the same loads succeed.
svg.text: 346 MB of code, with no hole to go to
Load 20, after 3 hours, fails. The object is 617 MB.
1384 MB are free, and the biggest hole is 330 MB.
The same objects. These loads succeed, and so do the next 380.
